name: JoyAI-Video-Edit
tagline: Real-time open-ended video editing with autoregressive diffusion
description: JoyAI-Video-Edit is the official open-source repository for a real-time, open-ended video editing system built on autoregressive diffusion models, released under the JD Open Source umbrella. The project presents a model that can edit videos in a real-time, instruction-following manner rather than being limited to fixed, predefined editing tasks, with Python tooling and deployment assets for reproducing and running the approach. It targets computer-vision researchers and developers interested in generative video editing and comes with deployment documentation and an operations package for running the model in practice.
highlights: Real-time, open-ended video editing driven by autoregressive diffusion
Official repository from JD Open Source with deployment docs and scripts
Python codebase plus deploy and ops tooling for practical reproduction
Instruction-following editing rather than fixed predefined tasks
curatorNote: A polished research release from JD's open-source arm — real-time open-ended video editing at 552 stars in under a week shows the appetite for generative video tools beyond the big labs.
